Picking up the secret tome, Gold Ship 
arrived in an unfamiliar land in search of 
the Eden described within—an Umamusume 
utopia.

The only problem: Trainer doesn't know the 
way back! Having been forcibly dragged 
away by Gold Ship, Trainer is completely 
at a loss.

Spending an entire lifetime here is a hard 
maybe-not. Gold Ship has started her 
glorious racing life... probably?
